concerns.text: T005 requires metrics_raw.csv 'conforming to metrics.schema.yaml (SC-002)' but specifies columns `dataset, method, metric_type, value, nominal_coverage, timestamp` while the schema requires `dataset_id`, `method_id` and restricts metric_type to {calibration_error, sharpness, coverage_error} — T005's `sharpness_cv` is not in the enum. The verification ('conforming to schema') is unexecutable as written; either the task's columns or the contract must be reconciled.

T006 writes CSV rows `dataset, method_pair, test_type=wilcoxon_signed_rank, p_value, significant, alpha, correction` and claims conformance to statistics.schema.yaml, but that schema is a JSON-object schema requiring `metric_analyzed` (enum calibration_error/sharpness_cv) which T006's columns omit. Additionally the stale stats.schema.yaml only permits test_type {welch_t, mann_whitney_u}, so any validator run against it will reject T006's output. The task's verification cannot pass deterministically until the contract(s) are updated or the task names which schema actually governs the CSV.

Constitution VI requires training/inference time and peak RAM recorded 'for each UQ technique evaluated' and VII requires computational-cost metrics to be tested for significant differences. T004 records only pipeline-level memory_peak_mb/total_duration_seconds and T006 tests only per-sample prediction errors. No task produces per-technique cost records or cost-metric paired tests, so these constitution requirements have no executable producer or verifier.

T009 says summary.csv and reliability_diagrams.png are 'produced by code/ scripts' but names no script path (unlike T007's figure). An implementer cannot deterministically locate or create the generating script; name the script (e.g. code/visualize.py) and include it in the verification.

T001 instructs updating spec.md SC-005 to list the three datasets, but spec.md revision 1.3 already contains exactly that list, making the amendment step and its verification condition already satisfied (vacuous). Drop the spec-edit clause or restate it as a verification-only check.

T008's edge-case test 'for datasets with < 100 test samples' has no fixture or synthetic-input mechanism named; specify how such a dataset is constructed in the test (e.g. a small in-test DataFrame) so the test is self-contained.
